title: Richtlinie zur mobilen Arbeit (Mitarbeiterhandbuch, Teil C)

language.typeRulesUnderDefaultLocale: measured: lang de matches the default locale de-DE

pages.basis: plain Paged.js measurement (3 pages) of justified, hyphenated German prose

expectedExit.derivation: All planted defects are warn rules (type/straight-quotes, type/spaced-hyphen, artifact/local-uri); no error-rule defect; the error rules measure every candidate.
expectedExit.environmentNote: Exit 4 with exitReason evidence/required-page-binding-incomplete is an environment failure (evidence binding not supported by the renderer), not an outcome of these documents; run the gate where the live path binds evidence (CI).

fontDependence: Only generic families (serif, sans-serif, monospace) are used. Line breaks, paragraph heights and therefore the position of flowing text depend on the fonts the renderer resolves; every construction fact below is built from explicit heights, fixed line pitches, forced breaks or SVG coordinates so that it does not depend on them, and every font-dependent outcome is listed as allowed.
features: planted file: URI and absolute path in links
clean counterparts: typographic quotes, en dashes, inch mark after a digit, code and kbd, digit ranges, single-letter formula, lang=en span, path in visible text

mustNotFire.why: running element: Paged.js clones it into a page margin box on every page (position: running). A margin-box copy is not a fragment of the document flow; no layout rule may treat the copies as fragments of one block (docs/limitations.md 0.6.0: 'Blocks carrying the same source id are not always fragments of one flow').

allowed.why: where a block splits and how many lines each fragment carries depends on font metrics and on Chromium's own widows/orphans handling inside the Paged.js fragmentainer

expectedDeclines.docsBasis: docs/rules/layout-orphan.md 'Skipped after a forced outgoing break'; the widow rule declines after a forced incoming break (declines list in the rule registry).

mustFire.why: spaced hyphens used as a dash in prose, no digit or operator nearby
spaced hyphen between two words in a table cell

mustNotFire.why: 7 - 18 Uhr: digits next to the hyphen (mathematical neighbourhood exclusion)
a - b: two single letters joined by the hyphen (formula), plus en dashes elsewhere in the run
Win - L is inside <kbd>, excluded structurally
the spaced hyphen sits in a lang="en" span; runs whose lang differs from the locale are excluded (docs/rules/type-spaced-hyphen.md)
Ein- und Ausschalten: a hyphen without spaces
no other spaced hyphen outside the exclusions above

mustFire.why: straight double quotes in German prose; the locale asks for „…“
straight apostrophe in German prose (’ expected)

mustNotFire.why: typographic „Präsenztag“ and ‚MA-Tag‘
24"-Monitor: a digit immediately before the mark exempts it (inch)
the only straight quotes are inside <code>, which is excluded structurally
typographic quotes inside a lang="en" span
no other straight quotation mark occurs in any text run outside code

allowed.why: the width of a paragraph's last line depends on font metrics
justified blocks: word gaps depend on font metrics and on whether hyphenation dictionaries are available

absolute build-machine path in a link

https URL
mailto: URL
